title: Cataloguing Cuttlefish
statement: This meticulous little cephalopod spends its days sorting sunken sea glass by hue across a sunlit slate floor, flashing soft bioluminescent footnotes along its mantle whenever a shade feels out of place. Between arrangements, it drifts contentedly through a forest of tea-colored kelp, pausing only to inspect passing bubbles with quiet, wide-eyed curiosity.
